title: Sunrise After Game Over
user_feedback: Less sweet, without a prominent melody
style: INSTRUMENTAL ONLY, no voice, humming, choir or vocal samples. Restrained electronic indie album outro, 75-100 seconds, 76 BPM with a loose implied 4/4 pulse. Less sweet and less song-like: texture, space and quiet physical detail, NO prominent lead melody, catchy theme, arpeggio, piano tune or guitar motif. Low rounded bass pulses, dusty brushed electronic ticks, softened analog noise, worn tape flutter and faint room ambience. Sparse detuned mid-low chords hover over a D pedal: Dsus2, Dm(add9), Cadd9/D; slow changes without a sentimental major-key cadence. Tiny isolated notes may appear then disappear, never develop into a tune. Calm, unsentimental morning after a long night; neither ominous nor triumphant. Gradually thin the texture, let room tone remain, natural fade. No lush strings, sparkling bells, cinematic swell, sentimental waltz, EDM build or big ending. Keep the tactile dusty electronic character of the rest of the album.
